mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with an actual temperature of 74 degrees at Verona Area High School, and the moon is currently in its first quarter phase.

The city has implemented a new rain barrel rebate program offering thirty dollars per barrel to help with stormwater management. Also, new sewer and stormwater utility rates were approved to keep our local infrastructure self-supporting and prevent system failures.

There is plenty to do today, including the Epic User Group Meeting, yoga at Insight Wellness, the final Concerts in the Park session, and trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, look out for live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a report from August 15, Verona police officers performed a welfare check on a vehicle that was swerving and eventually stopped, which led to the driver being arrested for her first O W I offence.
Culver's is featuring Double Strawberry as the flavor of the day, and they are open for you to visit until 10 PM tonight.
